_metadata.purpose: Seed of CDS view targets for HelpPortalFetcher. View-name list = views referenced in the three failing pipelines (OTC-E-0545, PTP-E-0190, ZOTC routing) + canonical SD/MM/FI/BP released views.
_metadata.howToUse: Set DARKHORSE_HELP_PORTAL_LIVE=true + DARKHORSE_HELP_PORTAL_TARGETS=<abs-path-to-this-file>, then run `node dist/index.js ingest help-portal-cds`.
_metadata.urlNote_IMPORTANT: The URLs below are EDUCATED GUESSES based on a help.sap.com URL pattern I observed (GUID-based path + .html suffix). They have NOT been verified — help.sap.com may use a different URL scheme. If the first fetch returns hasFields:false across the board, the URL pattern is wrong; manually browse to one view's reference page and update one entry to confirm the real pattern. Once one URL works, the others typically follow the same shape.
_metadata.scaleNote: After verifying the URL pattern works, expand from these 18 views to the full 7,566 released CDS views by walking the cloudification fixture (CDS_STOB entries with state=released). A follow-up task will automate this discovery via help.sap.com sitemap.

targets.notes: Sales document header — released CDS view replacing direct SELECTs on VBAK.
Schedule lines — replaces VBEP. Used in ATP / backorder scenarios.
Outbound delivery header — replaces LIKP. ZOTC routing pipeline wrapped LIKP unnecessarily.
Customer sales area data — replaces KNVV.
Purchase order item — replaces EKPO. Used in PTP-E-0190 PO enhancement scenario.
Business partner (leading object in S/4HANA for customer/vendor).
Customer master — replaces KNA1. Bug context: zcl_po_tms_badi_impl tried to SELECT lifnr/ktokk on I_Supplier; same class of mistake.
Supplier master — replaces LFA1. PTP-E-0190 SELECTed nonexistent `ktokk` field here.
Journal entry item — replaces BSEG / accesses ACDOCA.
Customer open items — replaces BSID (not maintained in S/4).
